# NEW 2026-11-18 territory rework, phase 1 (route C): province statuses. Generated by gen_territory_status.py; edit the generator, not this file.
# TEST ONLY (theme-tribute test buttons tribc1, tribc2, triblog, tribnow, tribage, tribfound; gen_territory_status.py). Never
# called by an action, an option or the monthly pulse. BYZ scope; the theme is BYZ var oe_trib_log_t.

# Comparison 1 (design theme-econ 5.2 test 1, case S/K): the crown's tax base and tax-and-trade income, and every
# crown location's tax base, before and after a theme is set up (press, set up the theme, wait until its buildings
# stand and a month has turned, press again). The diff line splits the change of location tax base into locations
# holding a theme building now (tbt) and the others (tbf, the control).
oe_ts_trib_test_c1 = {
    set_variable = { name = oe_trc1_ctb_new value = country_tax_base }
    set_variable = { name = oe_trc1_itt_new value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax }
    set_variable = { name = oe_trc1_inc_new value = monthly_income_total }
    set_variable = { name = oe_trc1_gold_new value = gold }
    set_variable = { name = oe_trc1_tbt value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_trc1_nt value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_trc1_tbf value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_trc1_nf value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_trc1d_tbt value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_trc1d_nt value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_trc1d_tbf value = 0 }
    set_variable = { name = oe_trc1d_nf value = 0 }
    every_owned_location = {
        save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_trib_l value = location_tax_base }
        save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_trib_d value = 0 }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc1_tb } save_temporary_scope_value_as = { name = oe_trib_d value = { value = location_tax_base subtract = var:oe_trc1_tb } } }
        if = {
            limit = { oe_ts_trib_theme_loc = yes }
            c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_trc1_tbt add = scope:oe_trib_l } change_variable = { name = oe_trc1_nt add = 1 } change_variable = { name = oe_trc1d_tbt add = scope:oe_trib_d } }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc1_tb } c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_trc1d_nt add = 1 } } }
        }
        else = {
            c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_trc1_tbf add = scope:oe_trib_l } change_variable = { name = oe_trc1_nf add = 1 } change_variable = { name = oe_trc1d_tbf add = scope:oe_trib_d } }
            if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc1_tb } c:BYZ = { change_variable = { name = oe_trc1d_nf add = 1 } } }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_trc1_tb value = location_tax_base }
    }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc1_ctb } set_variable = { name = oe_trc1d_ctb value = { value = var:oe_trc1_ctb_new subtract = var:oe_trc1_ctb } } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_trc1d_ctb value = 0 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_trc1_ctb value = var:oe_trc1_ctb_new }
    remove_variable = oe_trc1_ctb_new
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc1_itt } set_variable = { name = oe_trc1d_itt value = { value = var:oe_trc1_itt_new subtract = var:oe_trc1_itt } } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_trc1d_itt value = 0 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_trc1_itt value = var:oe_trc1_itt_new }
    remove_variable = oe_trc1_itt_new
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc1_inc } set_variable = { name = oe_trc1d_inc value = { value = var:oe_trc1_inc_new subtract = var:oe_trc1_inc } } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_trc1d_inc value = 0 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_trc1_inc value = var:oe_trc1_inc_new }
    remove_variable = oe_trc1_inc_new
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc1_gold } set_variable = { name = oe_trc1d_gold value = { value = var:oe_trc1_gold_new subtract = var:oe_trc1_gold } } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_trc1d_gold value = 0 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_trc1_gold value = var:oe_trc1_gold_new }
    remove_variable = oe_trc1_gold_new
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc1_n } change_variable = { name = oe_trc1_n add = 1 } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_trc1_n value = 1 } }
    debug_log = "OE_TRIB c1 now: m=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ts_month_index')|0];ctb=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc1_ctb').GetValue|2];itt=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc1_itt').GetValue|2];inc=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc1_inc').GetValue|2];gold=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc1_gold').GetValue|2];tbt=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc1_tbt').GetValue|2];nt=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc1_nt').GetValue|0];tbf=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc1_tbf').GetValue|2];nf=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc1_nf').GetValue|0];press=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc1_n').GetValue|0]"
    debug_log = "OE_TRIB c1 diff: m=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ts_month_index')|0];dctb=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc1d_ctb').GetValue|2];ditt=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc1d_itt').GetValue|2];dinc=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc1d_inc').GetValue|2];dgold=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc1d_gold').GetValue|2];dtbt=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc1d_tbt').GetValue|2];ntc=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc1d_nt').GetValue|0];dtbf=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc1d_tbf').GetValue|2];nfc=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc1d_nf').GetValue|0]"
}

# Comparison 2 (design 5.2 test 2): where a theme's money comes from. The theme's gold, realised balance, engine
# income, army pay (as the payment counts it), the tax base of its seat and post locations and its remittance,
# with the crown's gold, balance and tax-and-trade income; pressed again a month later the diff line gives the
# change of gold and bld = change of gold - pay + remitted, i.e. what the buildings bring the theme (the seat's
# fixed gold and tax-base shares) net of upkeep, which the engine income does not show. Each theme keeps its own
# previous reading. Theme scope (the test page calls it on its chosen theme), then oe_ts_trib_test_c2 in BYZ scope.
oe_ts_trib_test_c2_theme = {
    if = {
        limit = { always = yes }
        set_variable = { name = oe_trc2_g_new value = gold }
        set_variable = { name = oe_trc2_bal_new value = monthly_balance }
        set_variable = { name = oe_trc2_inc_new value = monthly_income_total }
        set_variable = { name = oe_trc2_pay_new value = oe_ts_trib_t_pay }
        set_variable = { name = oe_trc2_seat_new value = oe_ts_trib_t_seat }
        set_variable = { name = oe_trc2_post_new value = oe_ts_trib_t_post }
        set_variable = { name = oe_trc2_paid_new value = oe_ts_trib_last_v }
        if = {
            limit = { has_variable = oe_trc2_g }
            set_variable = { name = oe_trc2d_g value = { value = var:oe_trc2_g_new subtract = var:oe_trc2_g } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_trc2d_inc value = { value = var:oe_trc2_inc_new subtract = var:oe_trc2_inc } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_trc2d_seat value = { value = var:oe_trc2_seat_new subtract = var:oe_trc2_seat } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_trc2d_post value = { value = var:oe_trc2_post_new subtract = var:oe_trc2_post } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_trc2d_bld value = { value = var:oe_trc2d_g subtract = var:oe_trc2_pay_new add = var:oe_trc2_paid_new } }
            set_variable = { name = oe_trc2d_m value = { value = oe_ts_month_index subtract = var:oe_trc2_m } }
        }
        else = {
            set_variable = { name = oe_trc2d_g value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_trc2d_inc value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_trc2d_seat value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_trc2d_post value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_trc2d_bld value = 0 }
            set_variable = { name = oe_trc2d_m value = 0 }
        }
        set_variable = { name = oe_trc2_g value = var:oe_trc2_g_new }
        remove_variable = oe_trc2_g_new
        set_variable = { name = oe_trc2_bal value = var:oe_trc2_bal_new }
        remove_variable = oe_trc2_bal_new
        set_variable = { name = oe_trc2_inc value = var:oe_trc2_inc_new }
        remove_variable = oe_trc2_inc_new
        set_variable = { name = oe_trc2_pay value = var:oe_trc2_pay_new }
        remove_variable = oe_trc2_pay_new
        set_variable = { name = oe_trc2_seat value = var:oe_trc2_seat_new }
        remove_variable = oe_trc2_seat_new
        set_variable = { name = oe_trc2_post value = var:oe_trc2_post_new }
        remove_variable = oe_trc2_post_new
        set_variable = { name = oe_trc2_paid value = var:oe_trc2_paid_new }
        remove_variable = oe_trc2_paid_new
        set_variable = { name = oe_trc2_m value = oe_ts_month_index }
        if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc2_n } change_variable = { name = oe_trc2_n add = 1 } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_trc2_n value = 1 } }
    }
}
oe_ts_trib_test_c2 = {
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc2_cg } set_variable = { name = oe_trc2d_cg value = { value = gold subtract = var:oe_trc2_cg } } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_trc2d_cg value = 0 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_trc2_cg value = gold }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc2_cbal } set_variable = { name = oe_trc2d_cbal value = { value = monthly_balance subtract = var:oe_trc2_cbal } } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_trc2d_cbal value = 0 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_trc2_cbal value = monthly_balance }
    if = { limit = { has_variable = oe_trc2_citt } set_variable = { name = oe_trc2d_citt value = { value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax subtract = var:oe_trc2_citt } } }
    else = { set_variable = { name = oe_trc2d_citt value = 0 } }
    set_variable = { name = oe_trc2_citt value = monthly_income_trade_and_tax }
    debug_log = "OE_TRIB c2 now: m=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ts_month_index')|0];tag=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trib_log_t').GetCountry.GetTag];g=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trib_log_t').GetCountry.MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc2_g').GetValue|2];bal=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trib_log_t').GetCountry.MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc2_bal').GetValue|2];inc=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trib_log_t').GetCountry.MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc2_inc').GetValue|2];pay=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trib_log_t').GetCountry.MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc2_pay').GetValue|2]"
    debug_log = "OE_TRIB c2 now2: m=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ts_month_index')|0];seat=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trib_log_t').GetCountry.MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc2_seat').GetValue|2];post=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trib_log_t').GetCountry.MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc2_post').GetValue|2];paid=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trib_log_t').GetCountry.MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc2_paid').GetValue|2];press=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trib_log_t').GetCountry.MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc2_n').GetValue|0]"
    debug_log = "OE_TRIB c2 diff: m=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ts_month_index')|0];dg=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trib_log_t').GetCountry.MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc2d_g').GetValue|2];dinc=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trib_log_t').GetCountry.MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc2d_inc').GetValue|2];dseat=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trib_log_t').GetCountry.MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc2d_seat').GetValue|2];dpost=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trib_log_t').GetCountry.MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc2d_post').GetValue|2];bld=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trib_log_t').GetCountry.MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc2d_bld').GetValue|2];months=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trib_log_t').GetCountry.MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc2d_m').GetValue|0]"
    debug_log = "OE_TRIB c2 crown: m=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.ScriptValue('oe_ts_month_index')|0];cg=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc2_cg').GetValue|2];cbal=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc2_cbal').GetValue|2];citt=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc2_citt').GetValue|2];dcg=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc2d_cg').GetValue|2];dcbal=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc2d_cbal').GetValue|2];dcitt=[GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trc2d_citt').GetValue|2]"
}

# The remittance of the chosen theme: its terms, base, due, reserve and what it paid, with the crown's year total.
oe_ts_trib_test_log = {
    debug_log = "OE_TRIB off: TRIB_V2 = False in gen_territory_status.py"
}
# Run the chosen theme's remittance now (the once-a-month guard is cleared first), then log it.
# (theme scope; the test page calls it on its chosen theme, then oe_ts_trib_test_log)
oe_ts_trib_test_now = { remove_variable = oe_ts_trib_month oe_ts_tribute = yes }
# Toggle the chosen theme's founding month between now (in the 36-month grace: stable band) and 48 months ago.
# (theme scope; the test page calls it on its chosen theme, then oe_ts_trib_test_log)
oe_ts_trib_test_age = {
    if = {
        limit = { always = yes }
        if = { limit = { oe_ts_trib_age < 36 } set_variable = { name = oe_te_founded value = { value = oe_ts_month_index subtract = 48 } } }
        else = { set_variable = { name = oe_te_founded value = oe_ts_month_index } }
    }
}

# Found ONE theme now (test button tribfound), as the opening choice 'set up every historical theme' does
# (oe_theme_found_at_seat, gen_theme_setup.py: no authority cost, the seat and posts are ordered as there), at the
# most populous region centre of the crown where a theme may be founded (oe_theme_region_center_creatable). The new
# theme is kept in BYZ var oe_trib_found_t (the test page makes it its chosen theme). Press tribc1 before it.
oe_ts_trib_test_found = {
    if = {
        limit = { any_owned_location = { oe_theme_region_center_creatable = yes } }
        ordered_owned_location = {
            limit = { oe_theme_region_center_creatable = yes }
            order_by = population
            save_scope_as = oe_theme_seat
        }
        oe_theme_found_at_seat = yes
        set_variable = { name = oe_trib_found_t value = scope:target_building_country }
        debug_log = "OE_TRIB found: theme [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trib_found_t').GetCountry.GetTag] in region [GetCountry('BYZ').MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_trib_found_t').GetCountry.MakeScope.GetVariable('oe_theme_region_id').GetValue|0] (wait until its seat and posts stand and a month has turned, then press tribc1 again)"
    }
    else = { debug_log = "OE_TRIB found: no region centre of the crown where a theme may be founded now" }
}
